---
name: Install or play problem
about: The installer failed, or the game crashed/looks wrong
---

**What happened?** (which step, what you saw)

**Report:** run `./install.sh --report` and attach the zip (it has no game data or keys), or attach `local/logs/report-*.txt`
and the `local/logs/play-nxrt-*.log` of the run that had the problem.

**Computer:** distribution, GPU and driver (the report already includes these).
